story_id: st_onboarding
angle_headline: Our activation problem turned out to be a broken handoff in the data, and fixing it took activation from 31 to 44 percent.
angle_emphasis: Funnel data; Systems; Working across teams; Sync errors down by half

sentences.text: Our activation problem turned out to be a broken handoff in the data, and fixing it took seven-day activation from 31 to 44 percent.
Whenever a number stalls, the first thing I do is find where people actually drop before I touch anything.
At Fernhill, activation had been flat for two quarters and everyone blamed the welcome emails.
When I traced the events, people clicked the emails and then stalled on the bank-linking screen, and the email platform never heard about the stall.
So I decided to fix the handoff between the product events and the email platform, and I picked seven-day activation as the number to prove it.
I rebuilt the trigger so it fired off the stall event, worked with our product designer on the screen, and sync errors between the two tools dropped by half.
Within a quarter, seven-day activation went from 31 to 44 percent.

tmay_b2b_pitch.question: Tell me about yourself.
tmay_b2b_pitch.target_pitch: I'm a marketing ops lead who turns a messy stack into a pipeline the sales team trusts, then proves it in the numbers.

sentences.text: I'm a lifecycle marketer, and what I do best is find where activation and retention actually break, then build the journeys that fix them.
Right now I own lifecycle at Fernhill, a neobank, from the strategy to the sends to the weekly readout for the execs.
The clearest example is when everyone blamed our welcome emails, but people were stalling on bank linking, and fixing that took seven-day activation from 31 to 44 percent.
Before that I ran email at Brightwave and rebuilt our deliverability after a blocklisting.
Now I want to do the same for a consumer product where the first few weeks decide everything.

never_changes: Across all three cases, angles and pitches change only answer_first openings and type_fit. numbers_said, proof and the bank match are the same as they would be with no target.
